_readme: Prompt manifest. Each engine has a list of approved prompts. The actual prompt text lives in the referenced .md files under public/prompts/ and is sent to the model VERBATIM. This is the live store: the app reads it on every request, and edits made from the Settings UI are written straight back to the .md file. You can also edit a .md file directly and refresh the browser to pick it up. The first prompt in each list is auto-selected when that engine is chosen. Any [YOUR RING DESIGN] token is replaced at send time by the 'Ring / subject description' box (or a sensible default if left blank).
